message:
test(safety): fatal_exception sends no Hello before its host said input injection OFF; its logs and log root live in its own run folder (test-injection-finding r3)

Codex codex_test_injection_finding.md (fatal_exception; real-input 4), verifier fix-packet r3.

- run_with_client (probe-trap, wrapper-trap, wgc-throw, wgc-false, normal): a client Hello only after THIS launch said
  the whole "input injection disabled (unsupported mode) mode=none" line; another state ends the case at once with
  nothing sent (INVALID, counted); a host that dies before saying it gets no Hello at all.
- run() (std, winrt, none): no client and no socket at all -- startup faults, judged as such (OFF line not confirmed;
  zero connections, zero input).
- the fatal_*.log files and the pre-login log root are in a NEW folder of this run under the trusted test root
  (REMOTE60_TEST_TMP directly under D:/remote/remote/.claude/test-tmp, plain folder, no links -- as
  host_agent_punch_test); the one recursive delete is bounded to that folder (canonical path inside it, no link);
  without a valid root the test refuses to run, nothing created or deleted. Before: logs beside the executable and a
  fatal_prelogin_logroot there, remove_all'd at start and end -- outside the repository for a build outside it.
- e2e_injection_guard.hpp: REMOTE60_ALLOW_REAL_INPUT_TEST=1 is a technical switch for an approved isolated
  destination, not a permission; no agent sets it on a PC someone is using.

Built; not run (the verifier: no runs in this round).
